{{Quote|Five-blossom bread, my specialty.|Padmé Amidala, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Senate Spy" />}}
'''Five-blossom bread''' was [[Bread/Legends|bread]] made on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was given some of this bread by a Naboo ambassador visiting on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She saved it for a special occasion and offered it when her husband [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] visited her before the [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Mission to Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="Senate Spy" />
